title.zh: 材料家族：不是越硬越好
title.en: Material families: harder is not always better

subtitle.zh: 材料必须同时匹配光刻胶、刻蚀化学、目标层与去除路线
subtitle.en: The material must match the photoresist, etch chemistry, target layer and removal route

body.zh: Hard Mask优劣取决于整个Stack中的相对选择比，；不存在脱离刻蚀化学的固定材料排名。
body.en: Hard Mask performance depends on relative selectivity throughout the Stack;; there is no fixed material ranking independent of etch chemistry.

body.en: Characteristics; Often lies between thin Resist and SOC,; transferring the PR pattern into the carbon layer

body.en: Focus; Si content, optical n/k,; adhesion and O₂ plasma resistance

body.en: Etch Selectivity; Composition / Density; Stress / Adhesion; Removal Compatibility

body.zh: 更高密度：可能提升刻蚀耐受；但可能增加应力与去除难度
body.en: Higher density: may improve etch resistance,; but may increase stress and removal difficulty

body.zh: • 更高碳含量：可能利于部分Target Etch；但需控制Wiggling与Ash残留
body.en: • Higher carbon content: may benefit some Target Etches,; but Wiggling and Ash residue need control

body.zh: • 金属类：可改善特定Profile；但污染与后续兼容更严格
body.en: • Metals: may improve particular Profiles,; but contamination and downstream compatibility are more stringent

body.zh: HM与Plasma Chemistry不匹配；Carbon Line Wiggling；介质HM残留；金属污染/去除风险；层间Peeling
body.en: Mismatch between HM and Plasma Chemistry; Carbon Line Wiggling; Dielectric HM residue; Metal contamination / removal risk; Interlayer Peeling

body.en: Film thickness /; Uniformity; Composition; Stress /; Adhesion; Etch Rate /; Selectivity; CD / Profile /; Residue; Material and Stack; selection

body.zh: 相同材料在不同Target、Plasma Chemistry、温度和结构下可能表现完全不同。
body.en: The same material may behave very differently with different Targets, Plasma Chemistries, temperatures and structures.
